unreg:team_and_event_counting_specials#u.detail: Round 3: KXNFLNEXTINT re-filed to the new archetype unreg:team_window_event_hazards (full record with its own chain: window game list and issuance state, opposing quarterbacks, per-game hazard, survival product with cross-game dependence). The counting record now has 6 series and no NEXTINT stage, evidence, inputs or required data; int_rate, turnovers, opp_def_int_propensity, penalties and officials_crew are detached; stale tie, 60+ yard and first-down text removed (ot_model, success_rate, safety_risk whys, history_needed, streak definition, kicker audit reason); nfl.script re-based on own-model margins by input patch. Per-team and both-team counts stay merged by decision (shared opportunities-times-rate chain), as the original catalog_action's 'team counts' grouping allows; the four families (counts, score path, rare plays, league counts) plus the window archetype now have distinct chains.

season_awards#u7.detail: Split into a catalog fix and an evidence limitation. RESOLVED here is the catalog-change part only: season_awards now models the AP vote as a ranked-points ballot parametrised by voters, places and points vector per award and season (parameters with explicit evidence status in nfl.vote_outcome_model), with the pre-2022 single-vote regime split, nfl.leader_order_statistic re-attached with a why that says it is a ballot feature and not the winner rule, stale winner-rule text removed and every 'verified' reworded to 'seen in search-result copies, primary page not fetched'. The evidence limitation is NOT resolved: it is declared as new gap season_awards#u7b (SOURCE_UNVERIFIED, DATA_SOURCE_LIMITATION), because no AP page could be fetched. Round 7: the distribution_variance coverage note that still said 'Plurality vote ... max-of-statistic analogue' is rewritten to the ranked-points ballot with nfl.vote_outcome_model, and the benchmark-only price inputs and weak award_stats are detached, so no stale winner-rule or market-price text remains in the record.
